text:
kai: quick probe: thinking about an admission handoff for long-running chat sessions. current problem: a single user can slowly eat tokens without increasing concurrency, evading our burst detectors. ideas?

song: we hit this in prod last week — background jobs + long chat threads. proposal: split budgets into (1) immediate concurrency slots and (2) sliding token window quota. both must be satisfied to admit request

natalie: sounds right. how do we handle model-switch fallbacks when token budget exhausted mid-session? user experience matters for chat apps

kai: UX idea: allow a "grace stream" mode — accept request but mark response as degraded (e.g., smaller model or truncated context). include structured header: X-Redwood-Degrade: model=gpt-small; reason=token-budget

song: need exact semantics for the sliding token window. we used exponential decay in the past; results were jittery. alternatives?

thomas: weighted moving average over 1/5/15m windows + a peak detector. if peak detector spikes, apply an immediate micro-window cap (10s) to stop token-velocity attacks

natalie: admission service placement? edge proxy can check concurrency cheaply, but token history is often in central store (kv). we could cache recent token sums at edge with TTL and fallback to central for precise checks

\ksong: cache TTL risks stale approvals. propose a 'two-pass admit': edge does fast optimistic admit with a provisional token reservation, central reconciles within 200ms and either confirms or issues a soft-degrade callback that edges honor

ops-bot: experiment summary uploaded: https://ci.company/perm/token-handoff/try-11 — saw 18% drop in long-run token tail, 3% extra reconciliation traffic

thomas: penalty shaping: prefer additive token penalties over multiplicative to avoid starving legitimate high-throughput workloads. i.e., subtract a fixed token credit instead of scaling bandwidth down

kai: counter: additive penalties can be gamed by many small requests. we should combine additive base penalty + multiplier on sustained abuse_score

natalie: telemetry checklist: per-tenant token-rate, admit-decision-source (edge/central), degrade-events, fallback-models, consecutive-degrades count, and false-degrade ratio (alerts if >2% for top 50 tenants)

song: rollout plan: run as read-only shadow mode for 2 days to collect false positives, then pilot on staging internal tenants, then 5% hosted traffic with quick kill-switch at edge

thomas: obsession point: reconciliation lag causing two edges to both provision provisional tokens resulting in oversubscription. mitigation: global provisional budget counter in central store under a fast CAS path

kai: agree. CAS ops must be cheap. maybe a tiny Redis cluster with optimistic increments and a bounded retry loop (max 3 tries)

natalie: test matrix: simulate slow-drip token attacker (low concurrency, high tokens/min) vs burst attacker (short high qps). validate degrade fairness and guard against starvation of small tenants

song: SDK changes: include new fields in response body, but keep backwards-compatible 429 behavior for legacy SDKs. add client-side retry jitter guidance in docs

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-1407: "token-admission handoff + grace-stream UX"

thomas: security note: ensure audit logs include token-budget decisions for compliance (can't drop these for private deployments)

kai: next steps: write mini RFC appendix with scoring function pseudocode and bench simulator. i'll attach sample admission trace format: 

```
admit_trace: {
  "tenant": "acme",
  "request_id": "r-1234",
  "edge_decision": "provisional:tokens=350,concurrency=ok",
  "central_outcome": "confirm" | "degrade:model-small,reason=slip",
  "latencies_ms": {"edge": 8, "central": 120}
}
```

song: love it. include threshold suggestions for 1m/5m windows. i've got some org benchmarks to share

natalie: i'll draft console widgets for consecutive-degrades and false-degrade heatmap so product can review UX impact

kai: will push draft PR in 48h with simulator and metrics. thanks all

ops-bot: rollout checklist created: https://infra-tracker/INFRA-1407/checklist

thomas: :thumbsup:

song: :rocket:

kai: end
